egis.note: Official spec: DARTMAX TRZ 3.5号 30g / 40g, body 3.5号クラス (110mm). No sink type or sink rate stated. All 8 colours are offered in both 30g and 40g (no gaps). Successor to ダートマックスTR (2010); the official video title calls it ティップラン専用エギ. Announced 2025-10-01 for release mid-Nov 2025. Fits the TRZ アップウエイト add-on sinker (15g/20g/30g), which is an accessory and not listed here.

egis.note: LEGACY / INCOMPLETE. The predecessor of TRZ. Its official product page (URL above) now returns 404 and the model is no longer in the official FishLeague product list or sitemap (checked 2026-11-12). No page explicitly says it is discontinued, so discontinued is left false, but treat it as not part of the current official lineup. Models named on the official news posts: エギリー・ダートマックスTR30g-BK and TR40g-BK. The 号 size is not stated on any page I could reach, so size is null. The colours are only the ones named in official news posts (2022-2025), not the full chart. TR18 was announced for 40g-BK only (2025-07-23). TR17, TR19, TR20, TR21 and TR22 are in 40g-BK (2024-09-03), and that post says they were already in 30g-BK. The full TR colour chart and specs could not be retrieved because the Wayback Machine was unreachable.
